Package com.bilt.pos.session.storedvalue

Class StoredValueCard

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.storedvalue.StoredValueCard
public final class StoredValueCard extends Object
Identifies a stored value (gift) card for stored value operations and split-tender payment. 

 StoredValueCard.number("6006491260550218157")            // keyed card number
 StoredValueCard.scanned("6006491260550218157")           // scanned barcode
 StoredValueCard.swiped()                                 // terminal reads the mag stripe
     .withProvider("givex")
     .withExpiryDate("1228")
